composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Create an umbrella curled into a compact seashell spiral. Preserve several recognizable umbrella ribs along the spiral, but keep the handle short and inward. The matte violet canopy reveals warm orange lining between folds. Use one clear opening at the center and no rain or ocean context. Broad studio light and an ivory ground make the impossible continuous structure easy to read. Use stylized surreal sculpture. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
